title: Scooter Cover 190 × 71 × 117 cm – Reflective Strips and Buckles
seo_description: Cover for a mobility scooter, 190 × 71 × 117 cm, in black fabric with reflective strips. Buckles along the bottom edge hold it in place.
descriptionHtml:
The seat is wet before you've even sat down

The mobility scooter is parked outside the door whatever the weather, and when you're heading out you're met by a wet seat and damp controls. You wipe it down with a cloth before every trip instead of just sitting down and going.

A cover in the right size that goes over the whole scooter

The cover is sewn in black fabric to the dimensions 190 × 71 × 117 cm and goes over the whole mobility scooter. Reflective strips show in the dark, and buckles along the bottom edge hold the cover in place.

Features

  • Fits dimensions 190 × 71 × 117 cm – the cover goes over the whole mobility scooter
  • Visible in the dark – reflective strips are on the cover
  • Fastens along the bottom edge – buckles hold the cover in place
  • Covers the scooter completely, seat and all – a layer between the scooter and the weather

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
